title: Demo of the Project
note:
Project Management System
Estimates and time logging — backend API walkthrough
evidence:
PROJECT WORKFLOW

Create a project and assign team roles
Set and validate effort estimates
Log work with dates and notes
Edit and delete your own entries
Review actual hours and project activity

title: Project and roles
note:
Owner creates the workspace and invites the project team.
The following task is assigned to the Member account.
evidence:

HTTP 201

  "id": 1,

title: Set a task estimate
note:
A Manager creates a task estimated at 2.5 hours.
The task starts in Backlog.
evidence:
POST /tasks/projects/1/tasks/
HTTP 201
{
  "id": 1,
  "title": "Implement project API",
  "status": "Backlog",
  "priority": "Medium",
  "estimate_hours": "2.5",
  "actual_hours": "0.00",
  "version": 1,
  "assignee": "member@example.test",
  "message": "Task created successfully in Backlog"
}

title: Validate estimate boundaries
note:
Estimates accept half-hour steps from 0 to 9999.5.
Invalid input is rejected before any database write.
evidence:
Estimate       0 hours  -> HTTP 200 / saved 0
Estimate  9999.5 hours  -> HTTP 200 / saved 9999.5
Estimate     2.5 hours  -> HTTP 200 / saved 2.5
Estimate    -0.5 hours  -> HTTP 400 / INVALID_ESTIMATE
Estimate    0.25 hours  -> HTTP 400 / INVALID_ESTIMATE
Estimate     NaN hours  -> HTTP 400 / INVALID_ESTIMATE
Estimate Infinity hours  -> HTTP 400 / INVALID_ESTIMATE
Estimate   10000 hours  -> HTTP 400 / INVALID_ESTIMATE

title: Protect estimate permissions
note:
The assigned Member can work on the task.
Estimate changes remain restricted to Owner and Manager.

title: Record work and actual hours
note:
Two retained entries: 1.25 + 0.75 = 2.00 hours.
Each entry stores its creator, date and note.

title: Edit the date, note and hours
note:
The creator revises the entry through the API.
Stored date and note change; actual hours become 3.25.

title: Reject invalid edits without changes
note:
Bad quarter-hour values, impossible dates and non-text notes fail.
The previous 2.50-hour entry, date and note remain intact.

title: Protect time-entry ownership
note:
Another user cannot edit the creator’s time entry.
The API returns HTTP 403.

title: Delete an entry and recalculate
note:
The creator deletes the revised entry.
Only the 0.75-hour entry remains in the actual total.
